en-US.title: AFOMA Marketplace
en-US.subtitle: Handmade & ethical shopping
en-US.promoText: Shop handmade goods from artisans worldwide. Browse, checkout securely, track orders, and manage your account from your phone.
en-US.description:
AFOMA Marketplace connects you with independent makers and ethical brands—especially artisans in emerging markets. Discover authentic handmade products, support creative entrepreneurs, and shop with confidence.

SHOP
• Home, categories, and search
• Product and service listings with photos, variations, and reviews
• Seller shops and featured collections

CHECKOUT & ORDERS
• Cart, shipping quotes, and promo codes
• Secure payments (card, PayPal, and regional options where enabled)
• Order history and delivery details

YOUR ACCOUNT
• Email sign-in with one-time passcode verification
• Saved addresses, notifications, and referral earnings
• Buyer–seller messages with report and block tools
• Delete your account in-app (Account → Account details)

FOR SELLERS
• Seller dashboard, listings, orders, shipping, coupons, and earnings
• Create and manage products and services (including photo uploads)

Privacy policy: https://afomamarketplace.com/privacy-policy
Terms: https://afomamarketplace.com/terms-conditions
Support: contact@afoma.io
en-US.releaseNotes: Welcome to AFOMA Marketplace on mobile—browse, checkout, and manage your account with the same trusted marketplace experience as the web.

review.notes:
AFOMA Marketplace — App Review notes
Support during review: +13652936113 / contact@afoma.io

1. SCREEN RECORDING
{{VIDEO_URL}} — recorded on a physical iPhone with the latest iOS, starting from app launch: registration, sign-in, browsing, cart and checkout, orders, messaging with Report/Block, reporting a listing/review, seller tools, and in-app account deletion.

2. PURPOSE & AUDIENCE
AFOMA is a marketplace where independent makers and small businesses (mainly in Nigeria) sell handmade goods, local foods, beauty products and in-person beauty/wellness services to adult shoppers. It gives small sellers a storefront, orders and payouts without their own website, and gives buyers one place to discover and safely pay for these goods and services.

3. ACCESS & MAIN FEATURES
Sign-in is email + 6-digit one-time code (no password). Review accounts use a fixed code (no email needed). Same code for all:
• Buyer: {{BUYER_EMAIL}}
• Seller (active onboarding): {{SELLER_EMAIL}}
• Seller (expired onboarding / paused store): {{SELLER_EXPIRED_EMAIL}}
• Code: {{CODE}}
Account → Log in → email → code.
Buyer: Home/Categories → product → Add to cart → Cart → Checkout → Payment screen → Account → My Orders.
Payments in this build are live: go to the payment screen; completing payment is optional.{{COUPON_NOTE}}
Messages: Account → Messages → thread header: flag = Report user, ban icon = Block user.
Report content: product page → “Report this listing”; under a review → “Report”.
Seller (active): Account → Seller → Dashboard, Listing Management, Orders, Earnings, Seller plan status (read-only).
Seller (expired onboarding): sign in as {{SELLER_EXPIRED_EMAIL}} → Dashboard shows “Selling is paused”; Seller plan status shows paused state — no prices, purchase buttons, or links.
SELLER ONBOARDING AFTER EXPIRY (Guideline 2.1b): There is no In-App Purchase for seller plans. The onboarding period is an AFOMA seller business period (listing limits), not an App Store subscription. When it ends without a paid plan on our website, selling is paused (listings hidden); orders, messages and earnings remain. Plan payment is only on afomamarketplace.com (Stripe/Korapay). The iOS app shows status only (“Plan changes aren't available in the app”). No StoreKit products are configured.
Delete account: Account → Account details → Delete account (use a new test account, not the review accounts).
Buyer checkout is for physical goods and in-person services from third-party sellers only.

4. EXTERNAL SERVICES
Stripe (cards, Apple Pay), PayPal and Korapay (payments); Mailjet (email); Expo push with APNs/Firebase (notifications); our own Node.js API and Socket.IO (chat); Sentry (crash reports); Anthropic Claude API (optional AI help drafting seller listing text, reviewed by the seller before publishing).

5. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
Features are the same in all regions. Prices are shown in the user's local currency. Users paying in African currencies (NGN, GHS, KES, ZAR, etc.) check out with Korapay instead of Stripe. Selling is currently open to Nigeria-based sellers.

6. REGULATED / THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL
Not a regulated-industry app. Sellers are independent third parties bound by our Terms (https://afomamarketplace.com/terms-conditions). Payments are processed by licensed providers; AFOMA does not store card data. Listings are moderated and can be reported.

7. PRIVACY / ATT (5.1.2)
The app does not track users for advertising and does not use App Tracking Transparency (no ad SDKs or cross-app tracking). Purchase and order history are used only for app functionality (orders, delivery, support, seller payouts), not for tracking. App Privacy in App Store Connect is set so Purchase History is not used for tracking and “Data used for tracking” is No. Sentry is crash diagnostics only.
